question: Should OpenClaw restore `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated object-identical alias for shipped third-party plugin compatibility?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well proven, but repository policy treats public PluginRuntime API compatibility and deprecated aliases as maintainer-owned product direction.

options.title: Accept scoped alias
options.body: Land the alias after conflict refresh, document it as deprecated compatibility, and keep `channel.inbound.*` as the canonical path.

options.title: Reject runtime compat
options.body: Close or pause this PR and require affected third-party plugins to republish against `channel.inbound.*`.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for explicit deprecation-window wording or release-note context before accepting the alias.

recommendation.title: Accept scoped alias
recommendation.body: Land the alias after conflict refresh, document it as deprecated compatibility, and keep `channel.inbound.*` as the canonical path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the alias-removal commit and the inbound runtime refactor that created the compatibility question.
